[SWS_CM_10000] SOME/IP Compliance
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00205
⌈
The SOME/IP network binding shall implement the SOME/IP Protocol and the
SOME/IP Service Discovery Protocol defined in [4] and [6].
⌋
The byte order of the SOME/IP header fields is defined as network byte order by
[PRS_SOMEIP_00368].
